1.consolidated_definition: Planta olorosa de hasta 20 m de altura de tallo cilíndrico, abundantes pelos y hojas simples lanceoladas; su corteza posee propiedades curativas contra enfermedades pulmonares. Acanthaceae Justicia pectorales.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Perennial plant with a cylindrical stem of up to 20 m in height, abundant hairs and simple lanceolate leaves; its bark possesses curative properties against pulmonary diseases. Family Acanthaceae, genus Justicia pectoralis.
